p.title: Tree, shrub, herb, or climber/creeper?
p.challenge: Look at the stem! Sort each plant into the right group

items.why: Tall, with one thick, hard, woody trunk: a tree.
A tall plant with a woody trunk: a tree.
A huge tree with a thick trunk.
Medium-sized, many hard stems near the ground: a shrub.
Many hard stems close to the ground: a shrub.
Small, with a soft green stem: a herb.
Small, with a soft green stem: a herb.
Wheat is a small plant with a soft green stem: a herb.
Its weak stem climbs up with support: a climber.
The pea plant climbs with support: a climber.
Its weak stem spreads on the ground: a creeper.
It spreads on the ground: a creeper.
